text: AC2 makes a reference to an absent spec fail rather than pass silently, which means landing these checks before PAWL-029 fails on this very file — PAWL-032 cites PAWL-029 AC5, AC8 and AC10 and PAWL-029 is on an unmerged branch. Assumed failing is right and the ordering constraint is acceptable: a checker that passes references to things it cannot see is weakest exactly when a spec is mid-flight
